policy: Hard pass/fail. No partial credit. Every checkpoint must pass.
checks: Accuracy and grounded explanation: All technical explanations must be factually correct. No misleading claims.
Beginner-friendly language: Use simple English suitable for an Indian 12th-grade student with limited English. Explain difficult words.
Relatable worked example: Include at least one realistic everyday example and explain it step by step.
Why the topic matters: Explain the problem the topic solves and why it is useful.
Complete step-by-step workflow: Explain the complete process in the correct order without skipping important steps.
Key concepts explained: Explain every important technical term in simple language when it is first introduced.
Limitations and uncertainty: Explain important limitations and avoid promising guaranteed results.
Coherent teaching flow: Arrange explanations logically, from basic ideas to more advanced ideas.
Standalone lesson with recap and questions: Include an introduction, complete explanation, short recap, and at least three self-check questions.
